text.tspan: : square base cell 43 × 43 mm, gap 3 mm; a panel spans n cells
width of n cells = n × 43 + (n − 1) × 3 mm
Double column: 4 cells (181 mm) + 1 mm margin each side = 183 mm. Single column: 2 cells = 89 mm. Row height = 43 mm.
Fonts do not change with span: ticks 7 pt, axis titles 8 pt, panel letters 10 pt bold lowercase; a lone 89 mm panel uses +2 pt (9/10 pt).
Single column has no extra margin: 43 + 3 + 43 = 89 mm. A lone 89 mm panel (right) uses fonts +2 pt (9/10 pt).
